verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers card issuance, virtual cards, spend limits, API scopes, and treasury features, but nowhere documents a specific instant-freeze-and-reorder-replacement flow for lost/stolen physical cards; the closest mentions (fund lock/activate, cards:write scope) don't explicitly describe this finance-lead workflow. Missing for 10: explicit docs or UI walkthrough on freezing a lost/stolen card and requesting a replacement, any community/hands-on confirmation of this specific flow.
